# draw

Lines, labels and boxes a script places at chart coordinates (TradingView line.new, label.new, box.new). Create them in a handler such as `event.onCandle` and keep the ids to move or delete them later.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`draw.line()`](#draw-line) | Adds a line and returns its id. |
| [`draw.label()`](#draw-label) | Adds a label and returns its id. |
| [`draw.box()`](#draw-box) | Adds a box and returns its id. |
| [`draw.set()`](#draw-set) | Changes some properties of an existing object (e.g. |
| [`draw.remove()`](#draw-remove) | Deletes one object. |
| [`draw.clear()`](#draw-clear) | Deletes every object. |

### draw.line() {#draw-line}

```ts
draw.line(options: DrawLineOptions): number
```

Adds a line and returns its id.

Types: [DrawLineOptions](#drawlineoptions)

### draw.label() {#draw-label}

```ts
draw.label(options: DrawLabelOptions): number
```

Adds a label and returns its id.

Types: [DrawLabelOptions](#drawlabeloptions)

### draw.box() {#draw-box}

```ts
draw.box(options: DrawBoxOptions): number
```

Adds a box and returns its id.

Types: [DrawBoxOptions](#drawboxoptions)

### draw.set() {#draw-set}

```ts
draw.set(id: number, patch: Partial<DrawLineOptions & DrawLabelOptions & DrawBoxOptions>): boolean
```

Changes some properties of an existing object (e.g. moves a line's end). Returns false if the id is gone.

Types: [DrawLineOptions](#drawlineoptions), [DrawLabelOptions](#drawlabeloptions), [DrawBoxOptions](#drawboxoptions)

### draw.remove() {#draw-remove}

```ts
draw.remove(id: number): boolean
```

Deletes one object. Returns false if the id is gone.

### draw.clear() {#draw-clear}

```ts
draw.clear(): void
```

Deletes every object.

## Types

### DrawLineOptions {#drawlineoptions}

A line between two chart points. `x` values are bar times in ms (e.g. `candle.time.at(5)`), `y` values prices.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | `number` |  |
| `y1` | `number` |  |
| `x2` | `number` |  |
| `y2` | `number` |  |
| `color?` | `string` |  |
| `width?` | `number` |  |
| `style?` | `"solid" \| "dashed" \| "dotted"` |  |
| `extend?` | `"none" \| "left" \| "right" \| "both"` | extend past the points: "none" (default), "left", "right" or "both" |

### DrawLabelOptions {#drawlabeloptions}

A text label at a chart point; `style` is where its pointer goes: "down" sits above the point, "up" below it.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x` | `number` |  |
| `y` | `number` |  |
| `text?` | `string` |  |
| `color?` | `string` |  |
| `textColor?` | `string` |  |
| `style?` | `"up" \| "down" \| "left" \| "right" \| "none"` |  |
| `size?` | `"tiny" \| "small" \| "normal" \| "large"` |  |

### DrawBoxOptions {#drawboxoptions}

A rectangle between two times and two prices, optionally with text inside.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `left` | `number` |  |
| `top` | `number` |  |
| `right` | `number` |  |
| `bottom` | `number` |  |
| `color?` | `string` |  |
| `bgColor?` | `string` |  |
| `width?` | `number` |  |
| `style?` | `"solid" \| "dashed" \| "dotted"` |  |
| `text?` | `string` |  |
| `textColor?` | `string` |  |
